Name: Lumisteria Self Seeding Flowers
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod adds the ability for fully grown flowers next to each others to have a small chance to propagate. You want more interest for flowers? You play with some "no seeds in shop" challenge? Then you may like this mod. Include vanilla flowers and some mod compat.

How to use :
Fully grown flowers of same kind that are near each other have a chance between 1% and 10% to grow in nearby tilled spot.
You still need to do some work by ensuring you grow enough flower near each other, have the ground tilled for them to propagate, and have still time in the season for the new crop to grow.

This is made using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6577]Hybrid Crop Engine[/url], a mod that allows a concept i always find cool for more natural gardens.

Including :
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url] (tagetes, primrose, wood silk flower)
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20598]Lumisteria Serene Meadow[/url] (cornflowers, borage, snowdrop, calendula)
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22728]Wildflour Atelier Forager[/url] (chamomile, mint*)
You can enable or disable packs in the config.

(*while technically not a flower, it is blossoming in Wildflour atelier, and if you had/have mint, you know why it MUST be here)

For mod authors :
- You can let me know if you're ok with compat for your mod.
- If you want to include a similar concept in your mod, a credit will be nice.
- You can probably invent cool stuff with Hybrid Crop Engine. It has lot of potential, and my mods using it barely scratched it. :)
